# SvelteKit SPA with Node.js Backend - Project Instructions

## Project Overview
This is a SvelteKit Single Page Application with Node.js backend for Android deployment using:
- SvelteKit for frontend SPA
- Node.js/Express backend with RESTful API
- PostgreSQL database
- JWT authentication
- CORS configuration
- Nginx reverse proxy
- Capacitor for Android deployment

## Architecture
- Frontend: SvelteKit SPA with landing page and login page
- Backend: Node.js/Express REST API
- Database: PostgreSQL
- Authentication: JWT tokens
- Mobile: Capacitor for Android deployment
- Proxy: Nginx configuration
